integrity: The all-length upper bound and explicit construction are given directly; no outside theorem or computational certificate is needed for correctness. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: All-length theorem is restricted to binary words of Hamming weight exactly two and exactly one deletion; a distinct prior special-case formula in historical coding literature remains possible. Standalone finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Optimal single-deletion codes in the binary weight-two layer
